profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Favor Delivery

positions.title: Director Of Engineering
positions.description: As the Head of Engineering team, my responsibilities include leading, mentoring, and managing the Engineering team and working with the CEO, President, and other department leaders to define the company’s strategy and tactics.

positions.title: Sr. Engineering Manager
positions.description: As the Engineering manager of the Platform team (Core Services and Payments), my responsibilities include managing the engineers in the team, be the technical Product Managers of the team, worked on broader Engineering initiatives, and helped with company-wide strategy planning and business stakeholder meetings.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer - Payments
positions.description: As the first Payment engineer in the company, my responsibility was to build and maintain all aspects of our Financial Service at scale.

positions.title: Payments Architect
positions.description: Led the Payments team and architected the payments system infrastructure. Worked with the Finance & Accounting team on reconciliation system, financial dashboard and reporting.

positions.title: Sr. Web Developer - Payments
positions.description:
Team lead for many different projects including:
- Payment processor integration: PayPal, Credit card (PayPal, Merchant eSolutions, Payoneer), ACH (Wells Fargo, SvB, ProfitStars)
- Fee structure and calculation
- Currencies localization
- uShip Payment: a secure way for our customers to pay their carrier at uShip

positions.title: IT Services Software Developer
positions.description: Led the outsourced web development team in Beijing, China. Developed and maintained the web application portion of the ImageDirect project.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin
